story:
Whitman Lawn Care is a locally owned and operated lawn treatment company based in Scranton, Pennsylvania. We are a dedicated team of lawn care professionals committed to transforming your home or business into a stunning green oasis, and we have been doing it on Northeast Pennsylvania properties for more than 25 years.

We believe in partnering with our clients to create lush, healthy lawns that enhance the beauty of your space. That partnership starts with listening and testing rather than selling. Before we quote a program we walk the property, identify what is actually growing and what is actually eating it, and pull a soil sample. Much of the ground in this valley is shale-derived and runs acidic, which locks up nutrients even on lawns that have been fertilized faithfully for years. Correcting that comes first; feeding comes second.

We take pride in our work and stand behind every service we provide. Our commitment to quality ensures that you receive the healthiest lawn possible, backed by our expertise and passion for what we do. When something is not right, you are calling the people who did the work — not a national franchise routing you to a call center three states away. That is the whole advantage of hiring the company down the road.
